definition: A_N:=A/A_* is the dimensionless normalized fibre/source-coupling coordinate
needed_input: field scale A_* or parent canonical normalization from X/Z kinetic term

definition: beta_A^H:=partial_{A_N} ln mu_obs = partial_{A_N} ln G_eff + partial_{A_N} ln M_eff + partial_{A_N} ln(1+epsilon_mu)
needed_input: component derivatives or theorem-zero certificates for G_eff, M_eff, epsilon_mu

definition: J_A_source=rho_H beta_A^H/A_* for dimensional A, or rho_H beta_A^H for dimensionless A_N
needed_input: rho_H convention, A_* or canonical field units, source support/worldtube

definition: beta_A^T:=partial_{A_N} ln m_test_obs for test body/clock/matter readout
needed_input: test-body matter pullback and species/material marker map

definition: alpha_A(lambda_A)=K_A beta_A^H beta_A^T with lambda_A=sqrt(Z_A/M_A^2), after parent Green-function normalization
needed_input: K_A, beta_A^H, beta_A^T, lambda_A, real R10 bound curve

definition: D_a ln mu_obs=D_a ln G_eff+D_a ln M_eff+D_a ln(1+epsilon_mu) for a in {t,r,A,lambda,frame}
needed_input: channel derivatives and no-cancellation parent identity if terms are combined

definition: beta_A^EM:=partial_{A_N} ln EM_obs or EM source calibration coefficient
needed_input: EM stress/readout map and Poynting flux normalization
